identify_affected_packages.expected_solution: PR #134381 (nightly-2024-12-18) splits `rustc_attr` (`compiler/rustc_attr/`) into `rustc_attr_parsing` (parsing/validation) and `rustc_attr_data_structures` (shared types), in preparation for a future `rustc_attr_validation`. New source layout: a fresh `Cargo.toml`, `lib.rs`, attribute modules (`mod`, `allow_unstable`, `cfg`, `confusables`, `deprecation`, `repr`, `stability`, `transparency`, `util`), `session_diagnostics`, and `messages.ftl` all added under compiler/rustc_attr_parsing/; sibling data crate adds `Cargo.toml`, `lib.rs`, and modules `attributes`, `stability`, `version` under compiler/rustc_attr_data_structures/. Affected sibling crates: `rustc_ast_passes`, `rustc_builtin_macros`, `rustc_codegen_llvm`, and `rustc_codegen_gcc`.
evaluation_criteria: Must name all four affected sibling crates: rustc_ast_passes, rustc_builtin_macros, rustc_codegen_llvm, rustc_codegen_gcc
Must reference the new lib and Cargo manifest under compiler/rustc_attr_parsing/ and the new lib and Cargo manifest under compiler/rustc_attr_data_structures/
Must reference the original crate location compiler/rustc_attr/src/builtin.rs being phased out
Should mention this is preparation for a future rustc_attr_validation crate

classify_change_impact.expected_solution: Overall semver = **major** for the affected workspace edges. The old `rustc_attr` crate is renamed and its types redistributed; every dependent crate must update both its `Cargo.toml` (replace `rustc_attr` with `rustc_attr_parsing` and/or `rustc_attr_data_structures`) and its imports. Per-crate: `rustc_attr_parsing` = major (replaces `rustc_attr`; existing path-based imports break); `rustc_attr_data_structures` = major (new public API surface, but only for the type re-exports); `rustc_ast_passes`, `rustc_builtin_macros`, `rustc_codegen_llvm`, `rustc_codegen_gcc` = major because their `Cargo.toml` deps and import paths change. The compiler workspace is internal so no semver bump is published, but the *intra-workspace* contract change is unambiguously breaking.
evaluation_criteria: Must classify the change as a major/breaking refactor inside the cargo workspace
Must explain that every dependent crate's Cargo.toml must be edited (replace rustc_attr with one or both new crates)
Must explain that import paths in every dependent crate must be retargeted to the new module paths
Should note that as an internal workspace, no public semver is bumped, but the intra-workspace contract is broken

identify_boundary_violations.expected_solution: Source-of-change violations: (1) the old crate at `compiler/rustc_attr/src/builtin.rs` (and any remaining files under `compiler/rustc_attr/`) — being deleted or hollowed out; (2) new crate manifests added under compiler/rustc_attr_parsing/ and compiler/rustc_attr_data_structures/; (3) new crate roots `lib.rs` added under compiler/rustc_attr_parsing/src/ and compiler/rustc_attr_data_structures/src/; (4) attribute modules (mod, allow_unstable, cfg, confusables, deprecation, repr, stability, transparency, util) moved into compiler/rustc_attr_parsing/src/attributes/; (5) data types moved into compiler/rustc_attr_data_structures/src/ (modules: attributes, stability, version); (6) diagnostics resources `messages.ftl` and `session_diagnostics` under compiler/rustc_attr_parsing/. Downstream Cargo.toml + import edits: (7) `compiler/rustc_ast_passes/Cargo.toml` and `compiler/rustc_ast_passes/src/ast_validation.rs`; (8) `compiler/rustc_builtin_macros/Cargo.toml`, `compiler/rustc_builtin_macros/src/cfg.rs`, `compiler/rustc_builtin_macros/src/deriving/coerce_pointee.rs`, `compiler/rustc_builtin_macros/src/deriving/generic/mod.rs`; (9) `compiler/rustc_codegen_llvm/Cargo.toml`, `compiler/rustc_codegen_llvm/src/attributes.rs`; (10) `compiler/rustc_codegen_gcc/src/attributes.rs`, `compiler/rustc_codegen_gcc/src/lib.rs`. PR file count = 31.
evaluation_criteria: Must reference the new lib and Cargo manifest under compiler/rustc_attr_parsing/ and the new lib and Cargo manifest under compiler/rustc_attr_data_structures/
Must cite at least three downstream import edits, e.g., compiler/rustc_ast_passes/src/ast_validation.rs, compiler/rustc_codegen_llvm/src/attributes.rs, compiler/rustc_codegen_gcc/src/attributes.rs
Must mention that each downstream Cargo.toml (e.g., compiler/rustc_ast_passes/Cargo.toml) must be edited
